name: hugo-railway
description: Local Hugo publishing tools for the Signal CV monorepo.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and validate this Hugo site locally.
interface.longDescription: Launches the embedded Hugo MCP server against the Signal CV monorepo so Codex can inspect, draft, validate, and publish static content with the site's safety checks.
defaultPrompt: List the latest Signal CV articles.
Draft a new Hugo article in the right content bundle.
Build the site and report any content or link issues.
